description: On a `git commit`, checks the commit message and branch name for a ticket reference (task-cli id, GitHub issue #123, Linear ABC-123). If none is found and the commit isn't an exempt chore/WIP/merge, it warns (default) — or blocks in strict mode (REQUIRE_TICKET_STRICT=1) — that non-trivial changes should start from a ticket with acceptance criteria + motivation + user-impact. Enforces the strict-ticket-discipline skill; pairs with task-cli. on_error=open and default warn-only: process discipline, not a security gate, so a crash or a missed reference must never wedge committing.
